description: This PHP class 'OAuthService' provides methods for interacting with OAuth client data, including retrieving the client DAO, updating mobile client status, and checking if the mobile client is enabled.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: Service class providing OAuth client management functionalities, including enabling/disabling the mobile client and fetching client details.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDao
methods.description: Returns the OAuthClientDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: updateMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the mobile OAuth client based on the provided boolean parameter.

methods.name: getMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Checks if the mobile OAuth client is currently enabled.

methods.name: getMobileClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the mobile OAuth client if available.
